verdict.rationale: Bulk actions across many devices, users or keys are a fair question for a network-management platform like Tailscale, but the evidence pack never documents a native bulk-operation capability. Infrastructure-as-code providers, webhooks, cloud-init auto-install and the CLI are only adjacent building blocks or per-item tools, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
